translations.1: And you also — bring forward to yourself Aaron your brother and his sons with him, from among the sons of Israel, that they may lead worship for Me: Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, his sons.
translations.2: And make garments of holiness for Aaron your brother, for honor and glory.
translations.3: And you — speak to every wise of heart in whom I have perfected the knowledge of the spirit of wisdom, that they make the garments of Aaron, to consecrate him, that he may lead worship for Me.
translations.4: And these are the garments which they shall make: a breastpiece and an ephod and a robe, and an embroidered tunic and a turban and a sash. And they shall make garments of holiness for Aaron your brother and for his sons, that they may lead worship for Me.
translations.5: And they shall take the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet dye, and the fine linen.
translations.6: And they shall make the ephod of gold and blue and purple, and scarlet dye, and twisted fine linen — the work of a skilled craftsman.
translations.7: And it shall have two sewn pockets, which shall be upon its two edges.
translations.8: And the binding-straps of the ephod which are upon it shall be like its workmanship — of the same make as it — of gold and blue and purple, and scarlet dye and twisted fine linen.
translations.9: And take two crystal stones, and engrave upon them the names of the sons of Israel —
translations.10: six of them upon one stone, and the six remaining names upon the second stone, according to their order of birth.
translations.11: In the craft of gem-cutting, like the engraving of a signet-ring, you shall engrave upon the two stones the names of the sons of Israel; and make them surrounded by settings of gold.
translations.12: And place the two stones in the pockets of the ephod — stones of remembrance for the sons of Israel — and Aaron shall bear their names before God, upon his two shoulders, as a remembrance.
translations.14: And two chains of pure gold, made even, you shall make them in the work of braiding; and hang the two braided chains upon the settings.
translations.15: And make a prepared breastpiece, the work of a skilled craftsman, like the workmanship of the ephod — of gold and blue and purple, and scarlet dye and twisted fine linen you shall make it.
translations.16: And it shall be square, doubled — its length a span and its width a span.
translations.17: And set in it four rows of gemstones in arrangement. The first row: a red ruby, and an emerald, and a yellow stone.
translations.18: And the second row: a dark blue stone, and a white gleaming stone, and a bahraman stone.
translations.19: And the third row: an agate, and a jet stone, and a turquoise.
translations.20: And the fourth row: a blue stone, and crystal, and jasper. And they shall be aided by gold in their arrangement.
translations.21: And the stones shall be according to the names of the sons of Israel — since they are twelve, corresponding to their names — like the engraving of a signet-ring, the name of each one upon its stone; they shall be for the twelve tribes.
translations.22: And make for the breastpiece even chains, the work of braiding, of pure gold.
translations.23: And make for it two rings of gold, and set them at its two edges.
translations.24: And hang the two golden braids upon the two rings which are at the two edges of the breastpiece.
translations.25: And the other two ends of the two braids you shall hang upon the two settings, so that they come to rest upon the two pockets of the ephod, at its front.
translations.26: And make also two rings of gold, and set them at the two edges of the breastpiece, upon its border which is on the side of the ephod, from within.
translations.27: And make also two rings of gold, and set them opposite the two pockets of the ephod, from below, on the side facing its front, opposite the place of its joining, above its binding-straps.
translations.28: And they shall fasten it — from its rings to the rings of the breastpiece — with a cord of blue, so that it shall rest above its binding-straps, and not come loose from it.
translations.29: And Aaron shall bear the names of the sons of Israel in the prepared breastpiece upon his chest, when he enters the sanctuary, as a remembrance before God — always.
translations.30: And place in the prepared breastpiece the Lights and the Truths; and they shall be upon Aaron's chest when he enters before God; and Aaron shall bear the ordinance of the sons of Israel upon his heart before God — always.
translations.31: And make the robe of the ephod, the work of a weaver — the whole of it of blue.
translations.32: And its opening, which is at its top, shall be in its center; and a border shall surround it all around — the work of a weaver — like the opening of a coat of mail it shall be for it, so that it shall not tear.
translations.33: And make upon its hem pomegranates of blue and purple and scarlet dye, upon its hem all around; and bells of gold between them all around.
translations.34: A bell of gold and a pomegranate, a bell of gold and a pomegranate — upon the hem of the robe all around.
translations.35: And it shall be upon Aaron when he serves, and its sound shall be heard when he enters the sanctuary before God, and when he goes out — and he shall not perish.
translations.36: And make a diadem of pure gold, and engrave upon it like the engraving of a signet-ring: Holy to God.
translations.37: And fasten it with a cord of blue, and it shall be below the turban, at its front.
translations.38: And it shall be upon Aaron's forehead when he seeks forgiveness for the sins of the holy things which the sons of Israel consecrate — for all their gifts and their holy offerings — and it shall be upon his forehead always, that they may find favor before God.
translations.39: And embroider the tunic of fine linen; and make the turban of fine linen; and the sash you shall make in the work of an embroiderer.
translations.40: And for the sons of Aaron you shall make tunics; and make for them sashes; and caps you shall make for them — for honor and glory.
translations.41: And clothe them — Aaron your brother and his sons with him — and anoint them, and complete their required investiture, and consecrate them, that they may lead worship for Me.
translations.42: And make for them linen trousers, to cover the nakedness of their bodies — from the loins to the knees they shall reach.
translations.43: And they shall be upon Aaron and his sons when they enter the tent of the assembly, and when they draw near to the altar to serve in the sanctuary — lest they bear on account of it a burden and perish. This is an ordinance for all time, for him and for his offspring after him.
